items.headline: CoreWeave bonds rebound sharply after selloff that pushed yields near 15%
items.note: Bonds still trade below par (2031s ~82.8) after the rebound, so the market is not fully reassured on neocloud refinancing risk.

items.headline: AI debt fears surge as tech default insurance hits record highs; CoreWeave 5y CDS above 1,000bp, Oracle CDS ~288bp
items.note: CoreWeave CDS implies a very high default probability and Oracle CDS widened ~36bp in two days, with CoreWeave also facing $4.4B due by end-2026.
